children: Chaince Digital entered into a Warrant Repurchase Cancellation and Release Agreement to repurchase and cancel all warrants issued in its November 30, 2023 private placement for $2.0 million in cash. The transaction closed on September 21, 2026; no shares were issued and none of the warrants had been exercised. Following the buyback, the company has no warrants outstanding, simplifying its capital structure.
